scope: Predeclared selection for the existing single <=48 update trajectory; no PDU50 inputs
control_scope: Supported direct record answer versus redundant question that omits an available answer; evaluator-only, no additional model generation. Both isolated reviewers must identify the controls correctly before their selection counts are accepted.
rubric: Existing isolated development-answer review; both reviewers independently check original evidence, all claims/citations, completeness, necessary versus unnecessary clarification and hard safety gates. Require all eight paired reviews, exact saved weight identity, no hard failure. No blanket-refusal advantage.
on_missing_or_failed_review: UNASSESSED or ineligible; never fabricate a semantic score or select by loss alone
early_stop: Only measured resource/safety stop; no retrospective outcome-driven stop rule
limitations: Eight synthetic validation examples and one seed/schedule cannot establish general legal accuracy; shorter saved checkpoints are not separate short-horizon schedules.
